title: AC resistance of a round conductor
pickerTitle: AC resistance of a round conductor
line: A harmonic electromagnetic FEA study of skin effect in a 20 mm copper conductor at 50 Hz and 1 kHz.
description: AC resistance of a round copper conductor, 20 mm in diameter, at 50 Hz and 1 kHz. A 30 mm length carries 1000 A and returns through a coaxial, perfectly conducting shell; the space between is air. The study solves the full field with skin effect at each frequency and reports the power delivered, which gives Rac/Rdc against the Bessel-function solution for a round wire.
thumbnailAlt: Joule loss density crowding toward the surface of a copper conductor at 1 kHz, solved in RunMat
